name: Bragg Premium Nutritional Yeast Seasoning Flakes (Cheesy Umami, Dairy-Free)
whyItWorks: Delivers deep, savory, cheese-like umami flavor completely free of dairy, lactose, casein, or saturated fats. Fortified with essential B-vitamins (including B12, B6, and folate) that are frequently depleted in Crohn's patients with ileal disease.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Sprinkle 1–2 teaspoons over hot plain white rice, boiled potatoes, scrambled eggs, or gluten-free pasta for rich savory flavor with zero digestive distress.
